items.title: Migrate old ambient.shell pages to new split TT-aware bundles
items.premiseEvidence: 8 HTML pages + generate-pathways.mjs reference ambient.shell-3667694cc0.js which has NO TT default policy. TT burndown shows 30 violations from ambient.shell:367 (breadcrumb textContent) + 12 from :337 (nav innerHTML) since Jun 9 through Jun 30 — after S176's default-policy fix landed in ambient-core.bundle.js. Root cause: the old single-bundle predates the default policy; new split shells (ambient-core.shell-82efb5ec87.js + ambient-feature.shell-5b85ce5201.js) have the default policy as their first source.
items.successOutcome: Pages using the new split shells show no new ambient.shell TT violations in next probe window

L1.recipe: Update generate-pathways.mjs template to use ambient-core.shell + ambient-feature.shell; regenerate pathways pages; update nervous-system/index.html manually; run npm run build

items.title: Add TrustedScript policy to breadcrumb JSON-LD injection in breadcrumb-render.js
items.premiseEvidence: assets/breadcrumb-render.js line 121: s.textContent = JSON.stringify(ld) and line 91: nav.innerHTML = html.join(' ') — both unprotected by any TT policy. These get bundled into ambient-core.bundle.js (line 422/91), ambient-core.shell, AND the old ambient.shell. The default policy in ambient-core protects ambient-core.shell pages, but not old-ambient-shell pages. Adding a named policy to breadcrumb-render.js directly is belt-and-suspenders protection.
items.successOutcome: breadcrumb TT violations drop to 0 in next probe cycle

L1.recipe: Add vs-breadcrumb named policy before inject(); route s.textContent through createScript(); use DOM build for nav.innerHTML to eliminate that class entirely; npm run build to regenerate shells

items.title: Add getPolicy() guard to schema-injector.js to prevent InvalidStateError trap
items.premiseEvidence: schema-injector.js:26 shows 122 violations (Jun 12-24) AFTER S219 added the createPolicy fix. Root cause: createPolicy('vs-jsonld') throws InvalidStateError if the policy is already registered (e.g., loaded twice or by a parallel script). The catch block sets _ttScript=null, causing the fallback appendChild(createTextNode(json)) path — which fires TT violations since createTextNode on a script element is not protected by named policies. The default policy handles this only on pages with ambient-core loaded first.
items.successOutcome: schema-injector.js TT violations drop to 0; no new violations after fix deploys

L1.recipe: Add trustedTypes.getPolicy?.('vs-jsonld') attempt before createPolicy; also add getPolicy for 'default' as final fallback; eliminates the InvalidStateError silent-null trap

items.title: Replace ignis-platform.js capability card innerHTML with DOM construction
items.premiseEvidence: TT burndown: ignis-platform.js:108 shows 11 violations on Jun 15, Jun 24, Jun 27 (post-S253 — still live). Evidence: 'Element innerHTML|Pattern distribution'. Source confirmed: assets/ignis-platform.js line 108 uses card.innerHTML = '' + escHtml(cap.label) + '' + '' + escHtml(cap.detail) + ''. While escHtml() escapes content, the innerHTML assignment on a script-containing page triggers TT violations when the default policy isn't loaded first.
items.successOutcome: ignis-platform.js TT violations at line 108 drop to 0

L1.recipe: Replace card.innerHTML assignment with createElement/textContent DOM construction in buildCapabilities(); verifiable immediately via node --check
